]

start_date = datetime.strptime("2024-01-26", "%Y-%m-%d").date()
end_date = datetime.strptime("2024-03-07", "%Y-%m-%d").date()

# Alternative method: Use list comprehension for filtering and conversion
amounts_usd = [
    amount * EUR_TO_USD if currency == "EUR" else amount
    for _, date_str, _, _, amount, currency, status in data
    if status == "paid" and start_date <= datetime.strptime(date_str, "%Y-%m-%d").date() <= end_date
]

# Calculate average using sum and division
average = sum(amounts_usd) / len(amounts_usd)
result = round(average, 2)

print(f"ANSWER: {result}")
